#### Checked inherited records

[Installed inherited checked-record acceptance](../evidence/inherited-checked-record-promotion-20261018.md) covers the exact acyclic `Span → Ticket → Stamped` chain in all seventeen consumer profiles. Keep every parent as its named nested subobject. At each public input site, select the outer record constructor and mirror the parent hierarchy under `refinement.fields`, selecting each checked parent and refined payload constructor independently. The adapter applies those constructors in dependency order, then the outer constructor; a rejection preserves the caller's complete value, and a later valid call can recover. Repeated parameters may select different constructor trees. Lean-produced `Ticket` and `Stamped` results carry their own proofs, so result-only packages project the same proof-free payload hierarchy without input-constructor metadata. The [ordinary configuration fixture](../../tests/helpers/inherited-checked-record-fixture.mjs) and [Lean fixture](../../tests/fixtures/onboarding/inherited-checked-records/InheritedCheckedRecords.lean) show the complete contract.

That acceptance does not cover generic or recursive checked records, value-carrying receiver-dependent inherited fields, other index kinds, open value-dependent or zero-payload records, callbacks or owned positions.

Top-level inputs and results have installed acceptance in C/C++, Node JavaScript/TypeScript, browser pages, React, workers, Python, Rust, Ruby, .NET, Java/Kotlin, Perl, native PHP, PHP-Wasm and WIT/WASI. npm has [installed nested acceptance](../evidence/nested-checked-record-browser-20261016/index.json), C/C++ have an [installed nested archive](../evidence/nested-checked-record-native-20261016/index.json), .NET has an [installed NuGet archive](../evidence/nested-checked-record-dotnet-20261016/index.json), Java/Kotlin have an [installed Maven archive](../evidence/nested-checked-record-jvm-20261016/index.json), Perl has an [installed CPAN archive](../evidence/nested-checked-record-perl-20261016/index.json), native PHP has an [installed Composer archive](../evidence/nested-checked-record-php-20261016/index.json), Python has an [installed wheel archive](../evidence/nested-checked-record-python-20261016/index.json), Ruby has an [installed gem archive](../evidence/nested-checked-record-ruby-20261016/index.json), WIT/WASI has an [installed component archive](../evidence/nested-checked-record-wit-20261016/index.json), PHP-Wasm has an [installed Node/Chromium archive](../evidence/nested-checked-record-php-wasm-20261016/index.json), and Rust has an [installed Cargo archive](../evidence/nested-checked-record-rust-20261016/index.json). They cover direct and repeated parameters, arrays, lists, options, products, `Except`/`Result`, enclosing record fields, active variant fields and constructor-free container results. Select the record constructor and each nested checked field's constructor independently at every public input site; only an active variant branch runs. Generic, recursive, inherited, callback, owned and open dependent combinations remain unfinished.
